description: Use this to retrieve dated reference examples of Canadian secured cards and credit-building products. Confirm current terms and reporting arrangements with the provider. Returns the products available in Canada, grouped by how established they are, with which bureau each reports to. Single-bureau reporting is the detail most often missed: several well-known products report to Equifax only, which leaves the TransUnion file empty. Also flags the warning signs on upfront-fee credit repair and advertised-certainty lending. Returns bundled reference material, optionally filtered or calculated from inputs; does not fetch live data or change accounts.
